metadata.title: IGCSE Biology (0610) Paper 2 Topical MCQ Practice Bank
notes: Question stems, options, and diagrams are supplied as original embedded question images extracted from the uploaded PDF wherever possible.
Answers are matched against the source PDF answer appendix using paper code and original question number.
Question text and options are image-based; prompt_text/options are null by design.
Chapters 10 and 15 contain fewer than 50 topical entries in the source compilation; no questions were fabricated or duplicated to fill those chapters.
